featured_reviews.name: Crispin Cardoz
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently celebrated our mother’s 65th birthday at Imperia Banquets, and it was a wonderful experience from start to finish.

The venue is elegant, spacious, and beautifully maintained — perfect for a special celebration. The food was outstanding, with every guest appreciating the flavours and variety. Many even complimented the wedding rice and desserts!

A special thanks to Dominic, who ensured we got the best deal while still delivering exceptional quality. His support throughout the planning process made everything smooth and stress-free.

On the event day, Denzil managed the logistics seamlessly — from coordination to service — ensuring everything ran on time and without hassle.

Overall, Imperia Banquets delivered a memorable and heart-warming celebration for our family.
Highly recommended for anyone planning an event!

featured_reviews.name: Lionell Dcosta
featured_reviews.review_text:
We booked VV decor and caterers for our wedding in November 2024 at YMCA ground Vasai. What really caught us in the initial days was that Vikas dada was really prompt in his responses. He would immediately reply with quotations for food and quite quickly for decor as well. It was also very easy to meet him.

Our wedding decor was superbly done.
The speakers/music was okay. What really stood out was the food which was par excellence. We got great feedback on the food from many many guests. Also, the service was excellent. Our family members did not need to supervise the waiters and could enjoy the wedding. Everyone was served properly and abundantly. The starters just kept flowing unlike other places where they just have 1-2 round of starters.

Thanks so much @vikas V.V!

featured_reviews.name: RHEA GONSALVES
featured_reviews.review_text: A huge thank you to the amazing decorators and caterers who made our engagement truly special! The decor was breathtaking, with every detail perfectly executed to create a magical ambiance. The catering was equally outstanding—delicious food, beautifully presented, and loved by all our guests. Their professionalism, attention to detail, and exceptional service exceeded our expectations. We received endless compliments, and we couldn’t be happier. Highly recommend them for any event!

featured_reviews.name: Sweedal Sequeira
featured_reviews.review_text: We couldn’t have asked for a better team than VV to bring our wedding vision to life! They absolutely smashed the brief and went above and beyond in every way. The decorations were stunning—from the elegant entrance to the beautifully crafted dance stage, every detail was flawless. The catering was equally incredible, with everyone raving about the appetisers, main course, and desserts. Each dish was prepared to perfection and left our guests thoroughly impressed. Thank you, VV, for making our special day truly unforgettable. Highly recommend to anyone looking for excellence and creativity!

featured_reviews.name: Ben Sequeira
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve known this catering service for the past 4 years, and they’ve been my go-to choice for every family and extended family function. Not only is the food exceptional, but the decor and overall setup are always top-notch. The venue looks absolutely grand, thanks to their attention to detail. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for outstanding service and a memorable event experience!
